description: Curated safe, non-exploitative vulnerability indicators for FortifyOne VulnProbe. Expanded in v5.4 with additional exposure and misconfiguration checks.

templates.title: SSL Heartbleed indicator
templates.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to a patched version and rotate any exposed keys/certs.

templates.title: SSLv3 POODLE indicator
templates.remediation: Disable SSLv3 on all services; prefer TLS 1.2+.

templates.title: SSL CCS Injection indicator
templates.remediation: Patch OpenSSL / TLS stack; disable vulnerable cipher suites.

templates.title: SMB MS17-010 (EternalBlue) indicator
templates.remediation: Apply MS17-010 patches; block SMB from the internet; disable SMBv1.

templates.title: SMB MS08-067 indicator
templates.remediation: Patch legacy Windows systems; isolate or retire unsupported hosts.

templates.title: Anonymous FTP enabled
templates.remediation: Disable anonymous FTP; prefer SFTP with authentication.

templates.title: SSHv1 protocol supported
templates.remediation: Disable SSH protocol 1; allow only SSH-2.

templates.title: Redis exposed without authentication
templates.remediation: Bind Redis to localhost or private network; require AUTH; never expose to the internet.

templates.title: MongoDB exposed
templates.remediation: Require authentication; bind to private interfaces only; firewall from public internet.

templates.title: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch exposed
templates.remediation: Enable authentication; restrict network access; never expose publicly without strong controls.

templates.title: Docker API / daemon exposed
templates.remediation: Never expose Docker API to the internet. Use TLS + auth or local socket only.

templates.title: Kubernetes API server exposed
templates.remediation: Restrict Kubernetes API access; use RBAC, network policies, and private endpoints.

templates.title: MySQL / MariaDB exposed
templates.remediation: Bind to localhost or private network; require strong authentication; firewall public access.

templates.title: PostgreSQL exposed
templates.remediation: Restrict to private networks; require auth + TLS; never expose publicly.

templates.title: Microsoft SQL Server exposed
templates.remediation: Firewall SQL Server; require strong authentication; prefer private connectivity.

templates.title: RDP exposed to network
templates.remediation: Do not expose RDP to the internet. Use VPN or jump host + MFA + NLA.

templates.title: VNC exposed
templates.remediation: Disable or firewall VNC; prefer modern remote access with MFA.

templates.title: LDAP / LDAPS exposed
templates.remediation: Do not expose directory services to the public internet; require VPN + strong auth.

templates.title: SMTP service on high-risk exposure
templates.remediation: Ensure SMTP is not an open relay; enforce authentication and TLS.

templates.title: Telnet service detected
templates.remediation: Disable Telnet immediately; use SSH instead.

templates.title: NFS export potentially exposed
templates.remediation: Restrict NFS to trusted networks; use strong export controls and authentication.

templates.title: Memcached exposed
templates.remediation: Bind Memcached to localhost; never expose to the internet (amplification risk).

templates.title: CouchDB exposed
templates.remediation: Require authentication; restrict network access.

templates.title: RabbitMQ management / AMQP exposed
templates.remediation: Restrict management UI and AMQP ports to private networks; enforce auth.

templates.title: Kibana / similar dashboard exposed
templates.remediation: Require authentication; place behind reverse proxy with strong access controls.

templates.title: Jenkins CI exposed
templates.remediation: Never expose Jenkins to the public internet without authentication, authorization, and network controls.

templates.title: Portainer / container UI exposed
templates.remediation: Restrict Portainer to trusted networks only; enforce strong authentication.

templates.title: Directory listing enabled indicator
templates.remediation: Disable directory listing on web servers.

templates.title: HTTP TRACE method enabled
templates.remediation: Disable the TRACE method on web servers.

templates.title: Weak SSL/TLS cipher suites indicated
templates.remediation: Disable weak, NULL, EXPORT, and RC4 ciphers; prefer modern AEAD suites.

templates.title: SNMP service exposed
templates.remediation: Restrict SNMP to management networks; use SNMPv3 with auth+priv; avoid public community strings.

templates.title: IPMI / BMC management interface exposed
templates.remediation: Never expose IPMI/BMC to untrusted networks. Place on isolated management VLAN with strong auth.

templates.title: Git repository exposure indicator
templates.remediation: Block public access to .git directories; never deploy repositories with history to web roots.

templates.title: Environment / config file exposure indicator
templates.remediation: Ensure .env, config, and credential files are never web-accessible.
